prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: PHOTO ONLY portrait website hero plate, 1024 by 1536 pixels or taller, for one tall rack continuing across a page fold.
Primary request: Generate one dramatic, meticulously organized black network patch rack with saturated signal-red Ethernet patch leads. Match the approved reference rack's sense of depth, restrained industrial materials and extremely tidy cable dressing. The reference is a WEBSITE COMPOSITION only; use its right-hand rack photograph as visual guidance and exclude absolutely all graphics and typography.
Scene/backdrop: Single tall matte-black cabinet with a clear continuous left cabinet edge against near-black darkness. The cabinet occupies nearly the entire frame, with its thick left side panel visible in slight three-quarter perspective. The front face turns subtly toward the viewer. The cabinet continues naturally from the top to bottom of the portrait plate, without scene changes or horizontal breaks.
Subject: Four or five neat horizontal black patch-panel sections stacked vertically, consistent rack rails, tactile powder-coated steel and small hardware screws. RJ45 connectors with red molded boots plug into clean rows; individual patch leads turn downward in even, coherent loops. Parallel saturated red cable bundles turn in generous smooth curves down the right side and across occasional horizontal cable managers. Black hook-and-loop straps hold tidy groups. Every visible cable route should be coherent and carefully spaced.
Composition/framing: Tall portrait 2:3, close enough to see high-quality details but wide enough for continuous vertical cabinet depth. Clear straight left edge of cabinet at around the left 10 percent, substantial black side panel then the organized front panels across center and right. Cable bundle can approach the right edge. Avoid cutting off the characteristic rack edge. No blank red background: this is an opaque photo plate filled by black cabinet and near-black background.
Style/medium: Premium photorealistic editorial infrastructure photograph, controlled grazing soft light, rich graphite shadows, glossy restrained red jacket highlights, natural texture, crisp structured detail, no strong blur. Realistic photographic perspective, no distorted rack rails.
Constraints: PHOTO ONLY, edge-to-edge portrait. No website, UI, typography, headlines, copy, logos, watermarks, annotations, arrows, hotspots, decorative cable-line background or decorative linework. No people. No fake company work claim, no company name. No exposed copper, no tangled cables, no sparks. Minimal incidental hardware markings are acceptable but no invented prominent text. This is an illustrative imagined installation.
Output: One continuous tall photo, not a collage, not a screenshot, not an interface design.
